subject: Biology
title: Principles of Inheritance and Variation - DPP 04 (Dihybrid Cross & Non-Mendelian Ratios)
source_pdf: Principles Of Inheritance and Variation DPP 04.pdf

questions.question: Which of the following phenotypic ratios most likely indicates non-Mendelian interaction (epistasis) in a dihybrid cross?
questions.explanation: A 12:3:1 ratio suggests dominant epistasis, a deviation from the typical 9:3:3:1 ratio.

questions.question: Statement I: In polygenic inheritance, the F2 phenotypic ratio follows a bell-shaped curve. Statement II: The bell-shaped curve arises because each gene contributes equally and additively to the phenotype
options: Both statements are true, and II explains I
Both are true, but II does not explain I
I is true, II is false
questions.explanation: Additive effect of alleles in polygenic inheritance results in a normal distribution curve.

questions.question: A gene A is completely linked with gene B. If AaBb × aabb is crossed, what is the phenotypic ratio in the offspring assuming no crossing over?
questions.explanation: Linked genes inherited together give only two combinations: AB and ab. Offspring: AaBb and aabb 1:1 ratio.

questions.question: Mendel’s Law of Independent Assortment fails when two genes are located on the same chromosome and are _____; in such cases, they are said to be _____.
questions.explanation: Close proximity prevents independent assortment and causes gene linkage.

questions.question: Match the Following Column I Column II A) 9 : 3 : 3 : 1 I) Complete independent assortment B) 1 : 2 : 1 II) Co-dominance C) Continuous variation III) Polygenic trait D) 1 : 1 IV) Test cross of linked genes
questions.explanation: 9:3:3:1 dihybrid; 1:2:1 co-dominance; continuous variation polygenic; 1:1 test cross in linkage.

questions.question: A researcher crosses two pure lines of wheat differing in skin color. F1 shows intermediate color. In F2, she observes five different phenotypic classes. How many gene pairs are likely involved in this trait?
questions.explanation: Number of phenotypes in polygenic traits = 2n + 1 5 = 2n + 1 n = 2 gene pairs.

questions.question: Two genes are located 10 map units apart on the same chromosome. What proportion of gametes produced by a heterozygote will be recombinant?
questions.explanation: 1 map unit = 1% recombination. So, 10% of gametes are recombinant.

questions.question: Identify the incorrectly matched pair regarding inheritance patterns
Assertion
options: : Mendel could not explain the chromosomal basis of inheritance. Reason (R): Mendel was unaware of the existence of chromosomes and DNA during his time.
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation | |
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation
A is true, R is false (D) A is false, R is true
questions.explanation: Chromosomes and their role in heredity were discovered after Mendel's work.

questions.question: Which of the following are true regarding linked genes? I. They do not follow Mendel's law of independent assortment. II. They always segregate together during gamete formation. III. Crossing over between them leads to recombination. IV. Linkage strength is inversely proportional to the distance between genes.
questions.explanation: II is false — they often segregate together, not always. Crossing over and distance affect linkage.
